'''Not Implemented.'''

The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is a grave decoration that adds bonuses to Grave Decor {{Grave Decor}} when placed on a [[grave place|Gravesite]] after [[corpse]] burial. The number of positive points {{Graveyard Rating}} a grave can earn is based on the number of {{Skull|Red}} and {{Skull|White}}. A grave's positive score cannot exceed the number of {{Skull|white}} of the buried corpse. Any decorations added afterwards will be useless.  See [[Graveyard]] for more information. 

Adding or removing grave decor takes 5-10{{Energy}}.
